result.summary: The street provides a continuous sidewalk for pedestrians in a residential area, but lacks marked crossings or traffic calming infrastructure. The presence of parked cars along the curb creates potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the two-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points visible in the immediate residential area, increasing exposure risk for mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: A line of parked vehicles obscures the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to designate safe crossing points for residents.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) at crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and the road, which also serves as a traffic calming measure by narrowing the perceived street width.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a basic sidewalk adjacent to a wide roadway without a protective buffer. The lack of marked crosswalks and the presence of parked cars that may obstruct sightlines create a moderately hazardous environment for pedestrians.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or signals. Sightlines are significantly compromised by overgrown vegetation on the corner and parked vehicles along the roadway, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the wide street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate a pedestrian crossing area at the intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction (Vegetation)
hazards.description: Large, overgrown bushes on the corner block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction (Parked Cars)
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection limit visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps to ensure the crossing is accessible.
